description:
Get current holdings with quantity, cost basis, market value, and unrealized P&L.

    A short has negative shares, a positive avg_cost, a negative total_cost_book
    (the open credit), and a negative market value. Unrealized profit is positive.
    Cash includes short proceeds and is reduced when the short owes a dividend.
    Open cost of a long is already net of dividends still held. Realized P&L
    from closed longs and shorts is on get_portfolio_statistics.

    Args:
        portfolio_id: The portfolio UUID
name: get_positions
title: Get portfolio positions
